comparison.derivation: Two conducting junctions; sum of two source per-diode forward-voltage maxima. Both AC polarities use the original bench's 10 V input amplitude.

source_fact.scope: DF10M DFM; 1A; TA25 C source table default

limits: Isothermal DC rectification and two-junction voltage bound under both AC polarities; does not validate ripple, shared thermal behavior, surge or safe sustained output current.
